limits: Diagnostic token palette and solids-only interception are controlled test inputs, never production status or a proposed fix.
This tracks model-space face interiors at least one device pixel from either side edge; total image differences during camera motion are not used as a flicker metric.
Plan controls are seven real machinery top surfaces. Clipped open supports/wall partitions are not treated as painted horizontal caps.
Positive controls above the real wall inspection cut must retain visible columns; the gate cannot pass by suppressing all steel.
Current single-placement retained PWR source, one browser/GPU profile and two room zooms do not qualify arbitrary geometry, hardware or cross-placement coplanarity.
